# Southern Hospitality Group

> Locally hosted vacation rentals in Kentucky, bookable directly at https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co. Booking direct is always cheaper than the same stay on Airbnb or Vrbo. Hosted by Shane O'Donley and team (Airbnb Superhost, 850+ reviews, 4.96 average). Call or text 859-229-1524.

## Homes
- [Bootlegger's Retreat](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/bootleggers): Stanton · Red River Gorge. 4 bedrooms, 2 baths, sleeps 8, pet friendly. Hot tub, game room with arcade, fire pit, EV charger.
- [NEO](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/neo): Rosslyn · Red River Gorge. 2 bedrooms, 1 baths, sleeps 5, pet friendly. Private hot tub, wall of windows, fire pit, EV charger.
- [Trinity A-Frame](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/trinity): Rosslyn · Red River Gorge. 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, sleeps 5, pet friendly. Sunken hot tub, shuffleboard and arcade, fire pit, EV charger.
- [Bourbon Street](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/bourbon-street): Downtown Frankfort. 7 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, sleeps 14. Speakeasy bar, billiards, poker room, theater, walk to dinner.
- [The Woodleigh](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/woodleigh): Versailles. 4 bedrooms, 2 baths, sleeps 8. Covered patio with fire pit and outdoor TV, 1903 hardwoods.
- [Bourbon Trail Loft](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/bourbon-loft): St. Clair Street · Frankfort. 1 bedrooms, 1.5 baths, sleeps 4. Exposed brick, two queen beds, walk to restaurants and live music.
- [Historic Loft](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/historic-loft): St. Clair Street · Frankfort. 1 bedrooms, 1.5 baths, sleeps 2. King bed, exposed brick, dedicated parking space.
- [Herrington Haven](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/herrington-haven): Harrodsburg · Herrington Lake. 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, sleeps 10. Private dock and boat slip, hot tub, game room with pool table.

## Trip guides
- [Red River Gorge cabin rentals](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/red-river-gorge): Three pet-friendly Red River Gorge cabins near Slade and Natural Bridge, each with a private hot tub, fire pit and free EV charger. Sleep 5 to 8. Book direct.
- [Frankfort & Bourbon Trail vacation rentals](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/bourbon-trail): Stay in downtown Frankfort minutes from Buffalo Trace or in historic Versailles near Keeneland: a 1904 mansion for 14, a home for 8 and two lofts. Book direct.
- [Herrington Lake vacation rental](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/herrington-lake): Herrington Haven is a lakefront home near Harrodsburg, KY with a private dock and boat slip, hot tub, fire pit and game room. 3 bedrooms, sleeps 10. Book direct.
- [Large group vacation rentals in Kentucky](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/large-group-rentals): Kentucky homes for big groups: a 1904 Frankfort mansion for 14, a Herrington Lake house for 10, and Red River Gorge cabins that sleep 19 together. Book direct.
- [Vacation rentals near Buffalo Trace Distillery](https://www.southernhospitalitygroup.co/buffalo-trace-lodging): Stay minutes from Buffalo Trace in Frankfort, KY: a 1904 mansion for 14 about 5 minutes away and two downtown lofts 1.6 miles away. Book direct.
